name: host-local
description: The build host itself, unprivileged and local. It exists because the self-test's fixture targets run here, and a fixture judged against a baseline captured on a DIFFERENT kernel would be a two-variable experiment: a failure could be the fixture or the kernel difference. This baseline holds the kernel difference still. It declares no root capability — nothing here starts services or raises privilege on the owner's machine — so every root-pass row is skipped with that reason recorded in the manifest.
